question: What cosmic power arises from continually contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: A smoke-colored form is to be contemplated continually
The triple world is the object of the resulting power
The practitioner gains the ability to shake it
inference: By continually contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
